instruction: Candid corporate photograph, high-angle medium full shot. In an office meeting room, five colleagues stand around a wooden table covered with a laptop, notebooks, and papers, stacking their hands in the center. From left to right: the blonde woman in a white shirt (R4) in profile, the woman in a plaid blazer (R2) facing right, the dark-haired woman in a beige sweater (R3) facing forward, the wavy-haired blonde woman in a white cable-knit sweater (R1) facing left, and the young man in a white shirt (R5) in profile. They smile as they extend their arms over the table to join hands. Bright indoor lighting highlights the scene.
elements: R4 reaches in from profile at one end of the group to join the central hand stack, rather than standing out of the contact
R3 faces forward as she extends her arm into the shared hand stack, while R1 faces left as she joins the same stack
R2 faces right and participates in the central hand stack rather than acting as an onlooker
R1, R2, R3, R4, and R5 all extend their arms over the wooden table to stack hands in the center
The wooden table is covered with a laptop, notebooks, and papers
The interaction takes place in an office meeting room

questions.q: Is R4 reaching in from profile to join the central hand stack, rather than R4 standing apart while the others make contact?
questions.element: R4 actively joins the hand-stack contact instead of being an onlooker

questions.q: Does R3 face forward while extending her arm into the shared hand stack, rather than R1 being the forward-facing participant in that role?
questions.element: R3 has the forward-facing contact role while R1 faces left

questions.q: Does R2 face right as she reaches toward the central hand stack, rather than R2 being the left-facing participant described for R1?
questions.element: R2 has the right-facing reaching role while R1 is the left-facing participant

questions.q: Are R1, R2, R3, R4, and R5 all extending their arms over the table to join hands in the center?
questions.element: all five labeled colleagues participate in the central hand stack

questions.q: Is R5 in profile while participating in the same central hand-stack contact with R1, R2, R3, and R4?
questions.element: R5 is a profile participant in the group hand stack
